titel: Click Cuts, galerijbeeld 'Magnet holes in every cut' op Superhive: het hoofd van het paard komt los van de borst, magneten in de gaten, vergrootglas op één magneet (#137)
rol: You make or download 3D models and print them at home, but many models are bigger than your printer bed. You are browsing the Superhive (Blender Market) store for a Blender add-on that cuts a model into parts that fit your printer and go back together. You are now looking at the gallery images on the product pages to see how the parts connect.
